hero.headline: Precision measurements
hero.description: Metris Lab provides certified calibration services, measurement system analysis, and metrological expertise ensuring your instruments and processes comply with ISO/IEC 17025 and national standards.

about.label: Who we are
about.headline: Excellence in
about.description1: Metris Lab is an accredited metrological service centre specialising in precision calibration, measurement system analysis, and traceability verification. We combine rigorous scientific methodology with hands-on industrial experience to ensure your measurements are always reliable, documented, and traceable to national and international standards.
about.description2: From laboratory instruments requiring routine calibration to complex manufacturing systems needing full validation, we tailor every engagement to the specific measurement requirements and regulatory obligations of our clients.

services.label: What we do
services.headline: Comprehensive metrological services
services.description: From equipment calibration to system validation, we cover the full spectrum of precision measurement services tailored to your industry and application.
services.s1_desc: Precision calibration of laboratory instruments, dimensional gauges, pressure gauges, thermometers, and industrial measuring equipment with full traceability to state standards.
services.s2_desc: Comprehensive MSA studies — Gauge R&R, linearity, bias, and stability — to quantify and improve the capability of your measurement systems.
services.s3_desc: Our engineers come to you. We perform calibration and verification in your facility for large or installed equipment that cannot be moved.
services.s4_desc: Complete IQ/OQ/PQ validation protocols for manufacturing processes, automated systems, and quality-critical procedures.
services.s5_desc: Detailed uncertainty budgets prepared in accordance with GUM (JCGM 100:2008) and industry-specific measurement standards.
services.s6_desc: Expert guidance on metrological best practices, standards compliance, and implementation of measurement quality improvement programmes.

advantages.label: Why Metris Lab
advantages.headline: Trust built on
advantages.a1_desc: Every recommendation is grounded in measurement science and traceability requirements — never compromised by convenience.
advantages.a2_desc: All procedures follow ISO/IEC 17025, GUM, OIML, and relevant national metrological standards.
advantages.a3_desc: Streamlined scheduling and dedicated resources deliver calibration certificates quickly without sacrificing accuracy.
advantages.a4_desc: Our team holds national and international certifications across temperature, pressure, dimensional, electrical, and other measurement domains.
advantages.a5_desc: Every calibration is backed by full traceability records, measurement data, and conformance statements ready for audits.
advantages.a6_desc: Scheduled calibration programmes and proactive equipment tracking keep your measurement systems in compliance year-round.
advantages.stat_desc: On-time calibration certificate delivery rate across all client engagements
